CODE
Art. 2.3.42. 
Inventory 
In the event of dissolution of the legal regime by the death of one of the spouses, judicial separation as to property, divorce or legal separation for the reasons set out in Article 229 of the former Civil Code, the spouses or the surviving spouse are required to make an inventory of the movable property and the joint debts.
 This inventory, the content of which is governed by articles 1175 et seq. of the Judicial Code, may be drawn up under private signature where all the parties concerned of full age consent and, where there are minors or protected persons who have been declared incapable of disposing of property by virtue of article 492/1 of the former Civil Code, with the agreement of the Justice of the Peace to whom the matter is referred by petition.
 The inventory must be drawn up within three months of the death, the mention of the divorce or legal separation in the marriage certificate or the publication in the Moniteur belge of the extract of the decision pronouncing the separation of property.
 In the absence of an inventory within this period, any interested party may establish the extent of the joint assets by any means of proof.
